user.title: Tigo Setup
user.description: Choose the data source. **CCA** / **ESP32_WS**: enter the local IP (with CCA firmware >= 4.0.4 you will be asked to sign in to your Tigo account). **CLOUD**: Tigo cloud account, no IP needed.

cloud.title: Tigo account login
cloud.description: Sign in with your Tigo account (same credentials as the Tigo app). Local firmware detected: {fw}.

api_unreachable.title: Tigo cloud unreachable
api_unreachable.description: The Tigo cloud API has not responded for a while. Data is paused and will resume automatically when the service recovers; the integration backs off and honors throttling.
